blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for KYC Management System — agentic ai orchestration platform from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (health, throughput, cost and policy telemetry, roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing, autonomy tiers routed to approvals); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (saga patterns, compensation, idempotency, per-team/role token and action chargeback); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Every agent action is policy-checked and logged under immutable audit trails. Tool access is scoped per role with short-lived credentials; high-risk actions require approval workflows. Swarm's evidence pack maps to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF expectations for agentic systems.

items: platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: The control plane is sized for enterprise scale: decision and orchestration paths carry published latency budgets, and the evidence plane writes append-only logs that never sit on the hot path.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
